mentions.name: BeatSync
mentions.description: BeatSync is an open-source, browser-based tool that synchronizes audio playback across multiple devices with millisecond precision, requiring no app installation. It reports around 5K daily active users.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://www.beatsync.gg/

I launched this on HN over the summer, but it's millisecond-precise audio synchronization for multiple devices, performed purely in the browser! I'm sitting at around 5K daily active users now. Also, it's open-source!
